# iOS call-site index — backend surface → exact file:line (token-saving map)

The iOS app at `bonayd-ios/` is **frozen and `.gitignore`'d**, so this precomputed map
never goes stale. It exists so you **never traverse the Swift tree and never read a whole
`*Service.swift` / `*Models.swift` file** just to mirror a backend shape into the web app.

## How to use this (binding — CLAUDE.md rule 14 + `docs/mapping-protocol.md`)

1. Find the **Service method** (endpoint path) or **Model type** (field shape) below.
2. `Read` **only that file at that line** (`offset`/`limit` ≈ ±15) to copy the request-body
   fields and the decoded response fields. Do **not** read the whole file.
3. **Services** hold the endpoint path + request/response wiring; **Models** hold the exact
   Codable field names & types. Mirror endpoints into `src/config/endpoints.ts`.
4. Not here? Fall back to one narrow `rg --no-ignore`, then re-run `pnpm gen:ios-index`.
